entities.name: Online Bookstore
entities.description: A multi-region e-commerce platform providing catalogue browsing, secure checkout, reviews, and personalized recommendations for 1 million monthly active users.

entities.name: Book Shopper
entities.description: An end-user browsing the catalogue, purchasing books, and leaving reviews.

entities.name: Reviewer
entities.description: A user who interacts with the system to read and submit book reviews.

entities.name: Store Administrator
entities.description: An administrator managing system configurations, catalogue items, and store operations.

entities.name: Payment Gateway
entities.description: External payment processor such as Stripe or PayPal handling secure checkout transactions.

entities.name: Third-Party Shipping APIs
entities.description: External shipping providers handling order fulfillment and delivery tracking.

entities.name: Identity Provider
entities.description: Authentication and authorization service such as Auth0 or AWS Cognito utilizing OAuth2/OIDC.

entities.name: Email Service
entities.description: Amazon SES used for sending transactional and notification emails.
